# Graph operations · warp

Ports, defaults, and constraints come from the registered operations. Use `graph describe <op> --json` for the full structured record.

### warp.address

Compose rotation, zoom, polar tunnel and Copper row transforms into one UV field.

Origin: toolkit.
Samples the graph clock.

| Direction | Port | Type | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `width` | `number` | Required | pixels · {"finite":true,"integer":true,"min":1,"max":8192} |
| Input | `height` | `number` | Required | pixels · {"finite":true,"integer":true,"min":1,"max":8192} |
| Input | `transforms` | `array<record>` | `[]` | {"items":"record","maxItems":32,"entries":"rotate, zoom, tunnel or rows records in pull order"} |
| Input | `options` | `record` | `{}` | {"layout":"Plain named object"} · {"time":{"type":"number","unit":"seconds"}} |
| Output | `value` | `raster` | — | {"layout":"Interleaved samples on a positive integer grid","channels":[1,4],"finite":true} |

Guides: [guide](../headless-authoring.md#program-texture-addresses)

Get the runnable example with `ink-studio graph describe warp.address --example > example.json`.
Run it with `ink-studio graph run example.json`.

### warp.curveMap

Map pixels around a sampled curve to along-track UVs, signed across distance, tangent and coverage.

Origin: toolkit.

| Direction | Port | Type | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `path` | `path` | Required | art pixels · {"minItems":2,"dimensions":[2,3],"finite":true} |
| Input | `width` | `pixelCount` | Required | pixels · {"integer":true,"min":1,"max":8192} |
| Input | `height` | `pixelCount` | Required | pixels · {"integer":true,"min":1,"max":8192} |
| Input | `options` | `record` | `{}` | {"layout":"Plain named object"} · {"strokeWidth":{"type":"any","unit":"art pixels","description":"Full width or a width per path vertex.","default":8},"feather":{"type":"number","unit":"art pixels","constraints":{"min":0,"max":16},"default":0},"caps":{"type":"string","constraints":{"choices":["round","butt"]},"default":"round"},"overlap":{"type":"string","constraints":{"choices":["nearest","first","last"]},"default":"nearest"}} |
| Output | `value` | `raster` | — | {"layout":"Interleaved samples on a positive integer grid","channels":[1,4],"finite":true} |
| Output | `along` | `raster` | — | art pixels · {"layout":"Interleaved samples on a positive integer grid","channels":[1,4],"finite":true} |
| Output | `across` | `raster` | — | art pixels · {"layout":"Interleaved samples on a positive integer grid","channels":[1,4],"finite":true} |
| Output | `tangent` | `raster` | — | unit vector · {"layout":"Interleaved samples on a positive integer grid","channels":[2,2],"finite":true} |
| Output | `coverage` | `raster` | — | ratio · {"layout":"Interleaved samples on a positive integer grid","channels":[1,1],"finite":true,"min":0,"max":1} |
| Output | `segment` | `raster` | — | index · {"layout":"Interleaved samples on a positive integer grid","channels":[1,4],"finite":true,"integer":true,"min":-1} |
| Output | `length` | `number` | — | art pixels · {"finite":true} |

- Path XY and strip widths use native art pixels, with positive Y down.
- At most 4,096 nonzero segments, 1,048,576 output pixels, and 48 million clipped pixel/segment candidates.
- Coordinate ports share the winning span and coverage is the maximum across spans. Outside the strip, segment is -1 and other raster channels are zero.

Guides: [guide](../curve-raster-map.md), [guide](../headless-authoring.md#raster-warps-and-3d-projection)

Get the runnable example with `ink-studio graph describe warp.curveMap --example > example.json`.
Run it with `ink-studio graph run example.json`.

### warp.scanlines

Deform source rows while preserving a registered pivot, named anchors and sprite maps.

Origin: toolkit.
Samples the graph clock.

| Direction | Port | Type | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `source` | `raster` | Required | {"layout":"Interleaved samples on a positive integer grid","channels":[1,4],"finite":true} |
| Input | `anchors` | `record` | `{}` | {"layout":"Plain named object"} |
| Input | `maps` | `record` | `{}` | {"layout":"Plain named object"} |
| Input | `options` | `record` | `{}` | {"layout":"Plain named object"} · {"time":{"type":"number","unit":"seconds"},"filter":{"type":"string","constraints":{"choices":["nearest","linear"]},"default":"nearest"},"rows":{"type":"array<record>","description":"Increasing source rows with XY offset and horizontal scale.","default":[]},"wave":{"type":"record","description":"Horizontal wave amplitude and period in pixels, phase in turns, and rate in turns per second."},"padding":{"type":"array<number>","description":"Transparent left, top, right and bottom output padding.","default":[0,0,0,0]},"pivot":{"type":"vec2","description":"Registration point in source pixels."},"pin":{"type":"boolean","default":false},"horizontal":{"type":"string","constraints":{"choices":["linear","step"]},"default":"linear"}} |
| Output | `value` | `raster` | — | {"layout":"Interleaved samples on a positive integer grid","channels":[1,4],"finite":true} |
| Output | `field` | `raster` | — | {"layout":"Interleaved samples on a positive integer grid","channels":[1,4],"finite":true} |
| Output | `anchors` | `record` | — | {"layout":"Plain named object"} |
| Output | `maps` | `record` | — | {"layout":"Plain named object"} |

- Keys describe a forward map from source rows. Destination Y must stay strictly increasing.
- Named anchors follow the map. Registered auxiliary rasters use nearest sampling and match the source grid.

Guides: [guide](../headless-authoring.md#raster-warps-and-3d-projection), [guide](../headless-authoring.md#deform-registered-scanlines)

Get the runnable example with `ink-studio graph describe warp.scanlines --example > example.json`.
Run it with `ink-studio graph run example.json`.

### warp.timeRemap



Origin: toolkit.
Samples the graph clock.

| Direction | Port | Type | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `frames` | `array<raster>` | `[]` | {"items":"raster"} |
| Input | `history` | `any` | `null` |  |
| Input | `map` | `raster` | Required | {"layout":"Interleaved samples on a positive integer grid","channels":[1,4],"finite":true} |
| Input | `mask` | `any` | `null` |  |
| Input | `valid` | `any` | `null` |  |
| Input | `options` | `record` | `{}` | {"layout":"Plain named object"} · {"fps":{"type":"number","unit":"frames/second","default":12},"times":{"type":"array<number>","unit":"seconds"},"mode":{"type":"string","constraints":{"choices":["offset","absolute"]},"default":"offset"},"playback":{"type":"string","constraints":{"choices":["hold","loop","pingpong"]},"default":"hold"},"interpolation":{"type":"string","constraints":{"choices":["step","nearest","linear"]},"default":"linear"},"channel":{"type":"number\|string","description":"Raster channel or magnitude for two-channel motion.","default":0},"bias":{"type":"number","unit":"seconds","default":0},"scale":{"type":"number","default":1}} |
| Output | `value` | `raster` | — | {"layout":"Interleaved samples on a positive integer grid","channels":[1,4],"finite":true} |

- Use a frame bank history or 1–512 same-sized frames. Explicit times increase from zero and align with the frame array.
- Aligned single-channel masks use byte coverage to blend sample times. Invalid pixels use the graph time.

Guides: [guide](../headless-authoring.md#per-pixel-time)

Get the runnable example with `ink-studio graph describe warp.timeRemap --example > example.json`.
Run it with `ink-studio graph run example.json`.
